summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Torsten Greif to its Board of Directors. The filing notes Mr. Greif co-founded Four 20 Pharma GmbH, which sold a majority stake to Curaleaf. No forced departure, abrupt change, or material terms were disclosed; this is a routine board addition. The appointment is effective immediately with no stated compensation or special conditions. This event-driven filing is categorized as a Management Change only because the press release frames the appointment as a strategic leadership move, but it lacks elements of a contested or transformative event.
